products.name: Kyogre ex · Nintendo Power magazine
products.note: The Nintendo Power promo of October 2003 (the magazine's copy is not holofoil; the holofoil copy went to players of the Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire Challenge in August 2003: Bulbapedia, via search excerpt, and Collexy). The card is shown as the cosmos holo; the price is the magazine print's normal listing (TCGplayer market $43.82 normal, $314.66 holofoil), which is what the daily refresh reads.
